responsibility: Implements compile-time checking of `printf`- and `scanf`-style format strings against actual argument types. It parses C format specifiers, length modifiers, GNU extensions, and special `%` forms; classifies each specifier into an internal format enum; consults target C type sizes such as `long`, pointer, and `wchar_t`; and emits diagnostics when D expression types do not match the required argument or pointer types for formatted I/O calls.
